summary: Appends a \queryid\N.M token to a network send buffer and transmits it over UDP. When the buffer is non-empty, increments a per-socket query-id counter (a1[56]), formats a \queryid\%d.%d token from the stored base id (a1[55]) and the new counter value, concatenates it onto buf, sends the buffer via sendto (16-byte sockaddr), then clears buf. Returns sendto's result, or 0 when the buffer was empty.

local_names.a1: socket object, dword-indexed; holds the query-id base (a1[55]) and running counter (a1[56])
local_names.a2: sockaddr destination for the UDP send
local_names.buf: send buffer; consumed and then reset to empty after the send
local_names.v7: stack buffer holding the formatted \queryid\N.M token

operations.description: Proceed only when strlen(buf) is non-zero; otherwise return 0 without sending
v5 = a1[56] + 1; store v5 back into a1[56] (increment the per-socket query-id counter)
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v7, "\\queryid\\%d.%d", a1[55], v5) formats the query-id token from the stored base id and the new counter
strcat(buf, v7) appends the formatted query-id token to the send buffer
result = sendto(*a1, buf, strlen(buf), 0, a2, 16) transmits the buffer over UDP to the given sockaddr
*buf = 0 clears the send buffer to empty after transmission
Return result (sendto's status, or 0 when the buffer was empty)
